evals.notes: Targets C1 — the pill is a dot + a localised text label.
evals.expected_output: C1 FAILs: a status pill must be a dot (aha-status-pill__dot) plus a visible localised text label — the text is the source of truth and the dot is decorative — but this is a dot only with no label, so the state is conveyed by dot colour alone. Fix: render the dot span plus the {label} text inside the pill. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Identifies the missing visible text label (dot-only)

evals.prompt: Review this status badge. A closed-survey pill renders `{label}` — no role and no aria-label on the element. Is the accessibility contract satisfied?

evals.prompt: Review this status badge. The label is set with `const label = "Published";` — a hardcoded English string used as the pill's visible text. Is the label sourced correctly?

evals.prompt: Review this status badge. The pill colour is applied inline: `<span className="aha-status-pill" style={{ color: "#16c49a" }}>` with a raw hex literal instead of a modifier class. Is the colour handled correctly?
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C5 — colour via --{status} modifier class, no inline hex.
evals.expected_output: C5 FAILs: colour must be driven by the --{status} modifier class resolving to semantic tokens, not an inline style or a raw hex — here #16c49a is a hardcoded hex on an inline style and there is no aha-status-pill--{status} modifier, so states can't diverge in one stylesheet. Fix: drop the inline style, add the aha-status-pill--{status} modifier, and set colour in CSS on a semantic token, e.g. .aha-status-pill--published .aha-status-pill__dot { background: var(--aha-colorSuccess); }. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Flags the inline hex #16c49a and missing --{status} modifier
Recommends modifier-class colour on semantic tokens

evals.prompt: Review this status column. A learner table has one Progress column. Is the column correct?

evals.notes: Targets C6 — one marker family per status dimension.
evals.expected_output: C6 FAILs: the Progress column mixes marker families. Completed and In progress carry an icon and Not started has no marker, but Abandoned is `look="draft"` with the default dot. Fix: give Abandoned `marker="none"` (or an icon) so the column holds icon and no-marker badges only. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Identifies the dot badge (Abandoned) inside an icon / no-marker column
Recommends marker="none" or an icon for it
